### 2026-10-17 – # Outer Frame Done!

**5h**

# Outer Frame Done!

## tldr

Today, I finished the CAD for the outer frame of save my thinkpad. This features holes for screws, a v-rail and spaces for hinges. I based my measurements of a Lenovo L13 2-in-1 Gen 5.

## timeline

I started with sketching, which was very time consuming as I had to plan out and measure with my capilers. if anything goes wrong here or if I do not plan ahead, the whole CAD model is useless.

![image](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/u4daV3AON4Vg7wKuOmDpozDubBrsNyfk/0f2e878c43871c6878459577c99e8150bcd71606f89c5201d7fbb27b4ade7cd4.png)

Afterwards, I started work extruding!

![image](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/u4daV3AON4Vg7wKuOmDpozDubBrsNyfk/95d625f89b760c2e29e0a3343bdf3a554dcfee108524af816f026b640976f5e7.png)

This is where things get tricky. The V-rail was a STEP model off the web, and I had to mesh it to convert to body. I am running fusion on a (pretty crusty) computer meaning this took FOREVER.

![image](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/u4daV3AON4Vg7wKuOmDpozDubBrsNyfk/a6b9518737d56fc14a44c249ab9d80273cbc5df3d2cdedc8af5e7ebc0ce69827.png)

Afterwards, I got to work putting this into the frame.

![image](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/u4daV3AON4Vg7wKuOmDpozDubBrsNyfk/046303323ac1957c6d19c1ee1fff9104d0648ecafab23d1b6a2103e899b9536f.png)

Finally, I added holes. This was fun. This was easy. This was also boring as-

I got the modelling done after a while.

![image](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/u4daV3AON4Vg7wKuOmDpozDubBrsNyfk/1da65f2f9ae78b39cc07f84557d624e4e153016c3ef9a8becafd08fa1b603c86.png)

## next steps

CAD the other half and attachments! See you guys soon :D
